cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked about the rain earlier. Heavy. I pressed the flashing triangle like you did when you slowed down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the hazard-light button, not a brake. Is that why you hit my gate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, visibility. And yes, the rain made the road very hard to see.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you actually press the brake before the gate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rain eased just after we reached it. You'd asked whether it lasted all evening; it didn't.

reason: Ground the copied confidence in a specific misunderstood act and make it alter the exact Drive pursuit, with a final response based on B4 rather than an abstract mechanism summary.
